branch_verified_laminar_Re1000.renormalisation_discriminating_power: WEAK — do not use it to adjudicate the cross-family conflict. A laminar boundary layer has a systematically smaller form factor than a turbulent one, so copying the LBM (1+k) onto the anchor-Re ITTC-57 line biases the prediction towards the *lower* (1+k) family (here T14, 1+k 1.08-1.16) and away from the higher one (S1, 1+k 1.26-1.35). The renormalised column is reported only to show that the Reynolds gap explains the magnitude of the raw deviation.
branch_verified_laminar_Re1000.why_not_admissible: the case is a fixed-Re=1000 (lattice) laminar-flow verification against Blasius; the DTRC anchor lives at Re = 1.2e7..3.5e7 with a turbulent boundary layer. The Reynolds gap is ~4 decades, so the raw deviation measures the regime gap, not the solver.

branch_pending_highre_wallmodel.admissible_because: same hull family, same Re range, same fluid assumptions as the anchor (S1 family); this is the only in-repo LBM calculation in the anchor's Reynolds domain

grid_ladder.knob: cells per hull length L (h = 1/L), Re_lattice fixed at 1000
grid_ladder.what_changes: resolution only — nu_lb = u_lb*L/1000 shifts tau from 0.5144 to 0.5192, i.e. the physical problem is held fixed

case_reference_convergence.note: against its own laminar reference the primary caliber converges (|err| 8.15 -> 2.92 -> 0.95%), while the co-shipped mix50 archive diverges (1.56 -> 5.93 -> 9.21%): the ladder is instrument-sensitive at the few-% level, which is itself part of the resolution statement

grid_ladder.pathology_note: archived, not superseded; co-disclosed per erratum E2

tau_ladder.what_changes: IN AN LBM, TAU IS THE REYNOLDS NUMBER, NOT A NUMERICAL KNOB: u_lb and L are case-frozen, so tau from 0.51 to 1.0 sweeps Re_lattice from 1200 down to 24 (50x). A tau sweep therefore measures Re-sensitivity of C_D, and cannot be read as discretisation error.
tau_ladder.overall_note: G1 与 G3 通过，G2 在冻结口径下严格判 FAIL（仅 A 档带内），overall 由 G2 决定。同时披露：均匀网格上『负阻力病理』根本不存在，故 G1 的通过不等于『治愈成功』。
tau_ladder.caveat: u_lb 与 L 被案例冻结，故 τ 阶梯本身就是雷诺阶梯：nu_lb=(tau-0.5)/3，Re=u_lb*L/nu_lb。τ↑ 则 ν↑ 则 Re↓，本次 5 档跨 Re 1200 到 24（50 倍）。这不是等 Re 扫描，冻结的 Cf_ref@Re=1000 只在有效 Re 约 1000 的档上口径成立。

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: regime mismatch: Re_lattice = 1000 (laminar, Blasius reference) vs anchor Re = 1.2e7..3.5e7 (turbulent). The raw deviation is the Reynolds gap.
root_cause_hypotheses.quantitative_support: raw dev +952..+1462% at Re gap 4.07 decades; after transferring the LBM form factor (1+k) onto the anchor-Re ITTC-57 line the residual shrinks to -32.0..-6.1%, i.e. the bulk of the deviation is the Reynolds number, not the scheme
root_cause_hypotheses.test: run the same case at Re_lattice = 1e4/1e5 (same geometry, nu from the documented closed form) and check that the (1+k) ratio stays ~1.09 while the friction level follows the Re law

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: resolution starvation of the wall model: y+_mean 1878..4660 sits far outside the wall-law validity band, so the delivered friction is the *resolved-Re* (1e5) friction, not the anchor-Re friction
root_cause_hypotheses.quantitative_support: C_F_fric/ITTC(anchor Re) = 2.491..2.525 and nearly constant across the five anchors, i.e. a structural wall-chain level error, not a per-anchor drift; dev range +1296..+2963%
root_cause_hypotheses.test: re-run on a grid whose y+_mean lands in [30, 3000] (~1e8 cells, multi-node) per the in-repo promotion path

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: anchor itself is ambiguous: the two in-repo transcription families differ by 17.0%, larger than the 15% gate, so no simulation can be adjudicated to 15% against it
root_cause_hypotheses.test: acquire CRDKNSWC/HD-1298-11 Table 14 p.23 and re-register
